omissions_note: Captured in an active session after inspecting ALL_TOOLS and the global tools object via functions.exec in 3 batches: 15 top-level callable tools + 30 deferred Code Mode tools across 6 namespaces (user_settings: 2, mcp__Browser: 2, mcp__Automations: 7, mcp__Plugin_Management: 6, files: 11, skills: 2). Note: rich vertical search/widgets are bundled inside web.run (GenUI operations), and mode-gated tools such as Canvas were not loaded in this session.

tools.name: web.run
tools.description: Use this tool to access information on the web. Web information from this tool helps produce accurate, up-to-date, comprehensive, and trustworthy responses.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Newline-separated records specifying web operations, including search, open, click, find, image, product, business, availability, and GenUI operations.

tools.name: python.exec
tools.description: Execute Python code in your chain of thought for private analysis and computation.

tools.name: python_user_visible.exec
tools.description: Execute Python code that the user should see, such as code that makes plots, displays tables or dataframes, or outputs user-visible files.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Python code to execute in the user-visible environment.

tools.name: container.exec
tools.description: Utilities for interacting with a container, for example, a Docker container.

tools.name: container.feed_chars
tools.description: Feed characters to an exec session's STDIN. Then, wait for output, flush STDOUT/STDERR, and show the results.

parameters.name: chars
parameters.description: Characters to send to standard input.

parameters.name: yield_time_ms
parameters.description: Time to wait for output in milliseconds.

tools.name: container.open_image
tools.description: Returns the image in the container at the given absolute path. Only supports jpg, jpeg, png, and webp image formats.

tools.name: container.download
tools.description: Download a file from a URL into the container filesystem.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: URL of the file to download.

tools.name: personal_context.search
tools.description: Retrieves user-specific personal context gathered from multiple underlying sources, such as linked accounts, prior interactions, and other personal context streams.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The personal context to search for.

tools.name: bio.update
tools.description: Persists information across conversations, allowing more personalized and helpful responses. Supports saving new or updated information and requests to forget existing information.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Plain text containing new or updated information to persist, or a request to forget existing information.

tools.name: image_gen.text2im
tools.description: Creates new images and edits existing images. Returns a rendered image, not source code, editable structure, machine-readable data, or working interactions.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Deprecated parameter. Always pass null. Image generation or editing instructions are inferred automatically from the conversation context.

parameters.name: transparent_background
parameters.description: Whether to generate a transparent background.

parameters.name: is_style_transfer
parameters.description: Whether the user's request asks for a stylistic transformation.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: Optional settings for assembling a GIF from a spritesheet, including rows, columns, frame duration, and frame count, or disabling animation for a static image.

tools.name: safety_settings.get_family_info
tools.description: Call first for any Parental Controls question or action, including unnamed children. Returns Family status, product information, and authorized member IDs.

tools.name: safety_settings.get_parental_controls
tools.description: Read one family member's controls. Call get_family_info first; use only its latest readable_targets; do not call if empty.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Family member user ID returned by get_family_info.

tools.name: safety_settings.get_trusted_contact
tools.description: Call first for any Trusted Contact setup, status, privacy, or notification question. Returns product information and active, pending, or unconfigured status.

tools.name: safety_settings.update_parental_control
tools.description: Request a control change after get_family_info and get_parental_controls. Use only an authorized ID from the latest family result and can_update_in_chat=true. Requires explicit user approval.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Family member user ID returned by the latest get_family_info response.

parameters.name: control_id
parameters.description: Stable ID for the parental control to change.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: New value for the control. Can be a toggle, a schedule object, or selected values for a multi-select control.

tools.name: functions.exec
tools.description: Run JavaScript code to orchestrate and compose tool calls. Evaluates the provided JavaScript code in a fresh V8 isolate with top-level await support.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: JavaScript source code to execute. All Code Mode tools are available on the global tools object.

tools.name: user_settings__get_user_settings
tools.description: Read the user's ChatGPT settings, including personality, accent color, and appearance.
